etapes.fonction: Signal that a new topic starts and name the area.
etapes.gabarit_en: Now, let's [talk about / turn to] [domain]. / Next, let's turn to [X].
etapes.gabarit_fr: Passons maintenant à [X]. / Parlons maintenant de [X].
etapes.visuel: A single word or icon on black; an aerial transition between sets (prerecorded).

etapes.fonction: Build legitimacy: status, heritage or a success figure for what exists today.
etapes.gabarit_en: [X] is [the most popular] [category] [in the world]. / When we [created] [X] [N] years ago, we [wanted] to [mission].
etapes.gabarit_fr: [X] est [le / la] [catégorie] [la plus populaire] [au monde]. / Quand nous avons [créé] [X] il y a [N] ans, nous [voulions] [mission].
etapes.visuel: Speaker in a wide shot; big figure + label; timeline; the old product alone.

etapes.fonction: Open a gap: a life problem, a flaw in others (unnamed) or a rhetorical question.
etapes.gabarit_en: Today, [X] [fact A]. But [obstacle]. / Others [flaw]. / Wouldn't it be [great] if [wish]?
etapes.gabarit_fr: Aujourd'hui, [X]… Mais [obstacle]. / D'autres ont [défaut]. / Et si [souhait] ?
etapes.visuel: Screen showing the problem; checklist with empty circles; line drawing of competitors.
etapes.presence_detail: 7/8: missing from v2 (a catalyst instead). Explicit rhetorical question 5/8 (v5, v6, v1, v7, v8), 0/3 at product events.

etapes.fonction: Say the answer is coming, without naming it.
etapes.gabarit_en: And today, we [do just that]. / This year, [we go further]. / [teaser]… [And] here it is.
etapes.gabarit_fr: Et aujourd'hui, [c'est chose faite]. / Cette année, [nous allons plus loin]. / La voici.
etapes.visuel: Shot of the presenter; sometimes black before the film.

etapes.fonction: Show the object in an emotional way before the argument (major announcements).
etapes.visuel: Music film or hardware film: product floating, macros, exploded views; 10 s to 2 min 15.

etapes.fonction: Set down the word to remember.
etapes.gabarit_en: Introducing [Name]. / This is [Name]. / We call it [Name]. / It's called [Name].
etapes.visuel: Word or wordmark alone on a plain background; typographic reveal; live applause.
etapes.presence_detail: 8/8. Naming with a form like [we call it]: 3/8 (v5, v6, v2). Fake deliberation (a question about the name before giving it): 3/8 (v1, v7, v8). Applause after the name when live: 2/2, not after every name.

etapes.fonction: Say in one sentence what it does for the user, then judge it.
etapes.gabarit_en: [Name] is the [fast, easy] way to [benefit] without [pain point]. / [Name] is [verdict].
etapes.gabarit_fr: [Nom] est le moyen [simple et rapide] de [bénéfice] sans [douleur]. / [Nom] est [verdict].
etapes.visuel: Thesis line on screen; product alone.

etapes.fonction: Go from the person who names to the person who explains.
etapes.gabarit_en: To tell you [more], here's [First name]. / I'd like to [invite] [First Last], [role].
etapes.gabarit_fr: Voici [Prénom], qui va vous [en dire plus]. / Je [passe] la parole à [Prénom].
etapes.visuel: Walk-in + name/role lower third (prerecorded); stage entrance under applause (live).

etapes.fonction: Run each pillar as a loop: title card, technology, benefit, figure, use case, brief comment.
etapes.gabarit_en: [Product] delivers up to [N] times [metric] than [baseline: previous version]. [Brief comment.]
etapes.gabarit_fr: [Produit] offre jusqu'à [N] fois plus de [métrique] que [base : version précédente]. [Commentaire bref.]
etapes.visuel: Title card; big figure + label; chip diagram; comparison chart without a scale.
etapes.presence_detail: 8/8. Comparative figure (N times): 5/8 (v6, v1, v2, v3, v4); 0 in v5, v7, v8.

etapes.fonction: Show the gesture and how easy it is, in the first person.
etapes.gabarit_en: Let me show you [how it works]. → I just [tap] here… → Check this out. → Just like that.
etapes.gabarit_fr: Laissez-moi vous montrer [comment ça marche]. → Il suffit de [toucher] ici… → Et voilà.
etapes.visuel: Full-bleed device screen; hands-on demo; fiction played by actors; live demo on stage (live).

etapes.fonction: Let others say it works: press, partners, developers, users.
etapes.gabarit_fr: Voici ce qu'en dit [média]. / [Partenaires] [prennent en charge] [X] dès aujourd'hui.
etapes.visuel: Quote on black; grid of single-color logos; filmed testimonial; a third-party app as an example.

etapes.fonction: Bring attention back when the topic seems done; often opens the best argument.
etapes.gabarit_en: But that's not all. / And there's more! / But we [didn't stop] there.
etapes.gabarit_fr: [Mais] ce n'est pas tout. / [Et] ce n'est pas tout.
etapes.visuel: No visual of its own; a new slide.

etapes.fonction: Head off the objection: privacy, security, language or country limits. Privacy stated in the negative: 6/8 (v5, v6, v1, v7, v8, v4).
etapes.gabarit_en: [Data] stay [with you], so [no one] [, not even us,] can [access it].
etapes.gabarit_fr: [Vos données] restent [chez vous] : personne, [pas même nous], n'y a accès.
etapes.visuel: Manifesto line; ⚠/✓ lists; legal note at the bottom of the screen.
etapes.presence_detail: 8/8 in the broad sense (v2: security; v3: positive reassurance only). Privacy commitment stated in the negative: 6/8.

etapes.fonction: Close the topic: one name, three strengths. Comes before the return handover in about 2 cases out of 3 (44 out of 67); handover without a recap in 6/8 keynotes.
etapes.visuel: Bento grid (product or platform level); a list that gets checked off (service).

etapes.fonction: Say how much (price usually anchored, not always: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo, iPhone Air without a reference point) and when; price present in 5/8, availability in 8/8.
etapes.gabarit_en: [And even with] [gain], [Product] [still] starts at [price]. / You can [pre-order] [Product] [day]; [it ships] [date].
etapes.gabarit_fr: [Produit] est [disponible] à partir de [prix]. / [Précommande] dès [jour], disponible le [date].
etapes.visuel: Price slide (product + “From” + price); date slide (small line + huge date).
etapes.presence_detail: Availability 8/8; price 5/8 (v5, v6, v2, v3, v4); pre-order 3/8 (v3, v4; v8 for a third-party game).

etapes.fonction: Hand back, give a verdict, move on.
etapes.gabarit_en: Back to you, [First name]. → Thank you, [First name]. [One-sentence verdict].
etapes.gabarit_fr: Je [rends] la parole à [Prénom]. → Merci, [Prénom]. [Jugement d'une phrase].
etapes.visuel: Shot of the host; transition to the next set.

variantes.nom: Hardware product (v2, v3, v4, v6 Mac Pro)
variantes.differences: Film before the name (4/4 examples; no film for the Apple Watch in v3 or v4); pillars with figures against the previous generation or an unnamed PC; sub-handovers to domain experts; price usually anchored (still, same price, $30 less, overpriced competitor), except iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo, iPhone Air; pre-order and date; recap + bento; late name possible for a 2nd product (Pro Display XDR); price grouped at the end of the part for the iPhone lineup (v3); availability grouped for the Macs (v2); 5 to 25 min.

variantes.nom: Software feature (WWDC: v6, v1, v7, v8)
variantes.differences: Short form of 2 to 3 min; tension = a life moment; name in the middle (It's called, called, we're introducing); no film, no price, no handover in 3 examples out of 4 (v8: incoming and return handover); first-person demo; developer part (API) 4/4, a coda is common but not fixed; availability pushed to a grouped block (developer beta, public, fall; two blocks in v7); recap then Next; rapid-fire mode of 15 to 30 s for small features; no comparative figures in 2024-2025 (0 in v7 and v8).

Three voices: the CEO who names, the VP who explains, the CEO who concludes; long anchor with success figures for what exists today; visual tension (an empty checklist that gets checked off); name through We call it + wordmark + applause; mood film; privacy stated in the negative; price anchored on the total value then extended to the family, or no price on purpose; availability by country; recap through the list of principles; 15 to 34 min; content variant (TV+) with no interface, carried by seven blocks of guests.

variantes.nom: Technology or chip (v2 M1, v1 Apple Silicon, v7 Apple Intelligence, v8 Liquid Glass)
variantes.differences: Long heritage before the name; principles or requirements before the product; name held in suspense (we call it... M1) or category name before the product name; agenda announced in three parts; silicon expert in a lab set; proof through a chart without a scale against an unnamed PC, or through experience demos; no price; availability = transition schedule or compatible devices; recap as a triad + slogan; 5 to 37 min, often an event within the event.
